description: This file contains a benchmarking class 'GrainStorageBenchmark' for testing and measuring the performance of different Orleans grain storage backends, including memory, Azure Table Storage, Azure Blob Storage, and AdoNet. It includes setup methods for each storage type, a main run method that executes persistence operations asynchronously, and nested configurator classes for each storage backend.

classes.name: GrainStorageBenchmark
classes.description: A class that sets up, runs, and tears down performance benchmarks for different Orleans grain storage providers. It manages the lifecycle of a TestCluster, configures storage backends, and performs asynchronous operation tests.

methods.name: MemorySetup
methods.description: Configures and deploys an Orleans test cluster with in-memory grain storage.

methods.name: AzureTableSetup
methods.description: Configures and deploys an Orleans test cluster with Azure Table Storage grain backend.

methods.name: AzureBlobSetup
methods.description: Configures and deploys an Orleans test cluster with Azure Blob Storage grain backend.

methods.name: AdoNetSetup
methods.description: Configures and deploys an Orleans test cluster with ADO.NET grain storage.

methods.name: RunAsync
methods.description: Executes the performance test by running multiple concurrent grain persistence operations for a specified duration, then outputs metrics.

methods.name: RunAsync (overload)
methods.description: Performs repeated persistence operations on a grain instance until the running flag is false, collecting reports of each attempt.

methods.name: Teardown
methods.description: Stops all silos in the test cluster.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the test cluster resources.

classes.name: SiloMemoryStorageConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the Orleans silo builder to use in-memory grain storage as the default storage backend.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Adds memory grain storage as the default storage for the silo builder.

classes.name: SiloAzureTableStorageConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the Orleans silo builder to use Azure Table Storage as the default grain storage backend.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures Azure Table Storage with a connection string.

classes.name: SiloAzureBlobStorageConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the Orleans silo builder to use Azure Blob Storage as the default grain storage backend.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures Azure Blob Storage with a connection string.

classes.name: SiloAdoNetStorageConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the Orleans silo builder to use ADO.NET grain storage as the default backend.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures ADO.NET storage with a connection string.
